integrity: The claim is supported by an all-size combinatorial argument and two stand-alone exact finite checks. Earlier full-text antecedents cover related zero-field or chromatic observables; historical novelty is provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic Ising spins, uniform J>0, 2n-vertex Möbius ladder with n>=3, and zero temperature. The intermediate M=2 plateau in even cases is a finite-size effect, and neither positive-temperature criticality nor quantum behavior is asserted. A related 2014 field-dependent zigzag-ladder source was not accessible in full.
title: A parity-induced magnetization step on finite Möbius Ising ladders
